newsitem.title: UK: UK machine tool turnover down 2.8% in 3mths to Oct.
newsitem.headline: UK machine tool turnover down 2.8% in 3mths to Oct.

text.p: Turnover of machine tools in Britain fell by 2.8 percent in the three months to October, the Office for National Statistics said on Thursday.
This was due to a 3.8 percent drop in export turnover combined with a 2.3 percent fall in home turnover.
Compared to the same period a year ago, total turnover decreased by 5.9 percent, the ONS said.
Total orders on hand for machine tools at the end of October were 7.0 percent above their end-July level but 1.0 percent down on October 1995.
